observations: False "Permission denied." when a rule moves the ticket to a team

Creating (New Ticket form, API) or editing a ticket that an Owner Assignment › Team rule moves to a team the saver is not in answers 403 "Permission denied." (toast; the form stays open), although the ticket IS created (#616, #617, #605) / the edit IS saved (#650). Users will submit again → duplicates. Expected: saved message, then e.g. "You no longer have access to this ticket".
"Workflow rule ran" row missing for some rules

Rules whose condition uses Execution Time or Is Overdue (QA WF E2in, E3od, E3odT, E3odF) run (comment added "by workflow rule …", Execution History has the run) but no "Workflow rule ran" row is written. Rules on Contact / Created By / description have the row.
